newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Elliott to undergo tests on injured knee.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Elliott to undergo tests on injured knee.

text.p: Matthew Elliott will undergo tests after injuring his knee in a mid-wicket collision and is unlikely to bat again in the fourth test against West Indies, an Australian Cricket Board (ACB) official said on Monday.

Elliott limped from the pitch after colliding with batting partner Mark Waugh just before lunch on the fourth day's play. The Victorian left-hander retired hurt on 78, his highest score in three test innings.
ACB spokesman Patrick Keane told reporters Elliott had twisted his right knee in the collision and was unable to put any weight on the leg.
Keane said Elliott would undergo tests later this afternoon, adding that it was highly unlikely Elliott would resume his innings.
Australia were 144 for two in their second innings at lunch and held a lead of 171 with five sessions of play remaining. Waugh was 31 and Michael Bevan one not out.
